entities.name: Sebastian Ziani de Ferranti
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sebastian Pietro Innocenzo Adhemar Ziani de Ferranti was a British electrical engineer and inventor who pioneered high-voltage AC power in the UK, patented the Ferranti dynamo and designed Deptford power station.
